question: What electrolyte and reference electrode were used in the electrochemical tests of the V2O5 films on NiTi wires?
expect: 1 M LiClO4 in propylene carbonate; saturated calomel electrode (Pt foil counter) (p6.L120-126)
rendered: The electrolyte used in the electrochemical tests was a freshly prepared 1 molar lithium perchlorate (LiClO4) dissolved in propylene carbonate (PC) solvent. The reference electrode used was a saturated calomel electrode (SCE).
